title: Percutaneous Transhepatic Intrahepatic Portosystemic Shunt for Treatment of Portal Vein Occlusion With Symptomatic Portal Hypertension After Splenectomy
brief_summary: To evaluate the values of percutaneous transhepatic intrahepatic portosystemic shunt for treatment of portal vein occlusion with symptomatic portal hypertension after splenectomy.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* All patients with portal hypertension who have the history of splenectomy and have enough image information to confirm occlusion of portal vein

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients with known severe dysfunction of heart, lung, brain, kidney and other vital organs
